name: [RE-RELEASE] Grand Kaizen
desc:
🐉 Game Info:
Explore this strange world of sorcery to become a Powerful Jujutsu Sorcerer, or a High Grade Curse!

Progress into the best build with a diverse choice of weapons, a variety of powers, a remarkable storyline, and awesome visuals.

Whether you venture solo or with a party, make sure you're careful wherever you go...

🕹️ Controls:
[K] - View All Quests
[F] - Block
[M] - Menu
[LMB] - Light Attack
[RMB] - Heavy Attack
[E] - Interact
[Q + WASD] - Dash
